heading: Research
statement: My work sits at the intersection of autonomous systems, computer vision, and trustworthy machine learning. I study how perception fails, how those failures can be measured realistically, and how models can remain useful under attack and uncertainty.

themes.title: Secure Autonomous Perception
themes.description: Physical and black-box attacks, realistic evaluation, and defenses for camera- and LiDAR-based perception.

themes.title: Vision-Language Models for Driving
themes.description: Robust multimodal reasoning, traffic-scene understanding, and test-time adaptation for driving systems.

themes.title: 3D Vision and Point Clouds
themes.description: Efficient methods for point-cloud recognition, segmentation, tracking, and geometric representation learning.

themes.title: Trustworthy Machine Learning
themes.description: Reliability under distribution shift, uncertainty-aware deployment, and interpretable failure analysis.
